title: Charles's 1942 draft, Spike, and Norris Turney
summary: They sort out the order of personnel changes, Charles entering service in September 1942 and Norris Turney joining later in the Club Riviera days.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Was that before I went in the service,
now? No, I think he came a little ahead of the service.
You went in the service what year?
I went in the service in '42.
And we played Fitz' Bandwagon before then.
Well, maybe I'm ahead of myself. But I know we brought Spikes --
Spike and those, they all came in after I (Unintelligible) joined the service.
After -- that's right. They came after. Well, --
Turney? Is that his name, alto player Turney? Was he from Cincinnati or Cleveland?

Norris Turney, he's from Wilmington, Ohio. Wilmington. Turney came in later. He came in during the Club Riviera days. But nothing happened too exciting with the band, other than the band kept up with current music and see, we were playing every night. We had no nights off. And this is
